verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's docs say you can download the OpenAPI ("Swagger") schema alongside a Postman collection. A hands-on probe fetched it unauthenticated at /openapi/mesh-api.json and parsed it as OpenAPI 3.0.3, covering customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources. The 404s on generic guessed paths do not contradict this, since the spec lives at a different documented location. Missing for 10: confirmation that the spec covers every documented API area (e.g. IAM roles and webhook payloads).
